caption: the seven-deadly-climbing sim - lust, vanity and camouflaged minigames in apple city.
about: 7 sins (2005) is monte cristo's scandalous social climber: play adam or eve through a city of temptation, mastering minigames of voyeurism, seduction and camouflaged body parts while the seven sins meter tracks your style. The scandal was the marketing; the actual loop is a period-piece social ladder with a wicked sense of humor.
The windows build is delisted; a remake listing appeared on steam in 2025 but remains unannounced - the original stays archive-route only.
